clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for hot finished welded (HFW), hot finished seamless (HFS), and electric resistance welded (ERW) or high frequency induction welded (HRIW) plain carbon steel tubes for structural purposes.

clauses.title: Designation – Shall be
clauses.text: 2. Designation -   Shall be designated by their nominal bore and shall be classified as `Light', `Medium' and `Heavy' depending on the wall thickness (see Table 1). They shall be further graded as YSt  210, YSt  240 and YSt  310 depending on the yield stress of the material (see Table 2). The designation of the steel tubes shall, therefore, include the nominal bore of the tube, classification on wall thickness and grade of the material.

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 3. Material  —   The tubes shall be manufactured from steel conforming to IS 107 48 : 1995*

clauses.title: Sizes in weights
clauses.text: 4.1 Sizes in weights  and some  geometrical properties of tubes shall be as  given  in Table 1.

clauses.title: Tolerances – The following
clauses.text: 4.2 Tolerances - The following tolerances shall   apply: a)  Outside Diameter 1) Up to and including      + 0.4 mm 48.3  mm                -0.8  mm 2) Over 48.3 mm ±1.0  percent b) Thickness (for all sizes) 1) Welded tubes +Not limited -10 percent 2) Seamless tubes                   +Not limited 12.5 percent c) Weight +10 percent SUMMARY OF IS 1161 : 1998 STEEL  TUBES FOR STRUCTURAL PURPOSES. (Fourth Revision) -8 percent 1) Single tube light Medium ± 10 percent Heavy 2) 10 tonne lots light ± 5 percent Medium Heavy ±7.5 percent * Hot rolled  steel strip for welded tubes and pipes (first revision)

clauses.title: Workmanship – The tubes
clauses.text: 5. Workmanship - The tubes shall be cleanly finished and reasonably free from scale. They shall be free from cracks, surface flaws, laminations and other defects. The ends shall be cut cleanly and square with the axis of tube, unless otherwise specified.

clauses.title: Galvanizing– If the tubes
clauses.text: 6. Galvanizing- If the tubes are required in galvanized condition the zinc coating on the tubes shall be conforming to the requirements.

clauses.title: Straightness – Tubes shall
clauses.text: 7. Straightness - Tubes shall not deviate from straightness by more than 1 mm in any 600 mm length.

clauses.title: Lengths – The tubes
clauses.text: 8. Lengths - The tubes shall normally be supplied in random lengths at 4 to 7 m.

clauses.title: Ductility Test
clauses.text: 9.2 Ductility Test  -  The tubes of 50 mm NB and under shall withstand cold bend test and tubes above 50 mm NB shall withstand flattening test as prescribed in the standard. } } TABLE 1
